entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: In the end, your rehabilitation was not[n]carried through.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It appears I have overestimated you...
What happened?
Where are the townspeople?
Where did my teammates go?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle*

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You incompetent prisoner!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: The assistance that we provided was all[n]for naught.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Humans are more apathetic... and more[n]foolish than I had thought them to be.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: The world will soon see its ruin...
Ruin?
Am I dead?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You have lost the game.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You were meant to bring change to[n]mankind as a Trickster, but it seems[n]that was too much for you.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: In accordance to the game's rules, the[n]defeated must pay a price.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Your life is forfeit.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I sentence you to be executed.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Executed?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: God's decree is absolute...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: My experiment has come to naught...[n]Everything is over.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Grant that man a swift death.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: If that's what our master wishes...
You're going to execute me?
Are you serious?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I-It just means that you weren't an[n]upstanding prisoner!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: That... may be true, but...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: What is the matter? Carry out his[n]sentence at once.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Are we really going to kill him?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Don't falter now! It's all his fault for[n]losing the game!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: All right, Inmate. We now proceed to[n]the execution of your sentence.
I can't die yet.
Where are my teammates?
They're going to kill me at this[n]rate. I need to do something...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: How insolent... To think you'd still show[n]your rebellious will after all that...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Ready, Justine?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: If our master orders so... then it cannot[n]be helped...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Let us show our strength to this... prisoner[n]who just doesn't know when to give up.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: ...Understood.

entries.speaker: Caroline & Justine
entries.en: Death to the criminal!

entries.speaker: Caroline & Justine
entries.en: Death to the criminal!
